title: ID0422527-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP/N8 160355435] FW upgrade to V6.1.3
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Dear Helpdesk,
With the permission from the customer, please kindly help to update the Sicharge
D MP/N8 160355435, charger ID tthtkL, from V4.0.11 to V6.1.3.
Please kindly perform the FW update only at Singapore time (GMT+8) at night
2100H to 0700H (+1).
The XF3 is using customer’s own SIM card with an allowance of 100GB. The
firmware V5.0.23 is pre loaded into the charger already.
Thank you
Edna Seah
SI E LC-SG
